title: phone-mic promo page
brief: Promotional page for phone-mic, a Linux tool that turns an Android phone into a PipeWire microphone. Terminal interface language: boxed frame, monospace type, big wordmark, scattered pixel stars, key-hint status bar. Default palette is warm amber (from tui/phone_mic_tui.py); all twelve palettes are switchable from the page itself.

artboards.title: Warm terminal
artboards.tradeoff: Hero-first and emotional, closest to the reference image; pushes the install command below the fold. This board is generated from the built site by site/scripts/snapshot-design.ts, so it cannot drift from the page that ships.
